description: Check which formats a card (or multiple cards) is legal in. Use this when a user wants to know if a card is legal, banned, or restricted in formats like Commander, Modern, Standard, Legacy, or Vintage. Accepts a single card name or an array of up to 50 card names.

cards.description: Card name or array of card names (max 50)

format.description: Specific format to check (e.g., "commander", "modern"). Omit for all formats.

name: check_legality
